Let \(x=PQ=PS=PR\), so \(Q,R,S\) all lie on the circle centered at \(P\).

Since the diagram has \(PR\) inside \(\angle QPS\), let  
\[
\angle RPQ=\angle RPS=\alpha.
\]
Then
\[
\alpha+\alpha=\angle QPS=60^\circ,
\]
so \(\alpha=30^\circ\).

Thus the minor arc \(\widehat{QS}\) has measure \(60^\circ\) and contains \(R\). Therefore \(\angle QRS\) intercepts the major arc \(\widehat{QS}\), whose measure is
\[
360^\circ-60^\circ=300^\circ.
\]
By the inscribed angle theorem,
\[
\angle QRS=\frac{300^\circ}{2}=150^\circ.
\]

\[
\boxed{150}
\]
